scope: Compatibility of 17 planned YJK scenarios with the current toolchain; not authored Bench release, per-question certification, paid LLM accuracy, or permission to change paper references.
reviewMethod: Read all original task and model fields; map each exact topology/load/property/output/edit requirement to production interfaces and native capability evidence. Do not substitute an assumed rectangular future section table.
authoringContract: The final task property tables and image/DXF attachments are not yet authored. Correct full inputs using the reviewed capabilities require no further tool implementation; native precision limits remain reported separately.
repairsThisAudit: Numeric custom sections compile via fixed native reference carrier without altering source properties; verified six elastic rigidities and axes, explicitly excluded from physical section tables/design checks.
Source materials with explicit steel/concrete category and complete numeric properties can use an audited elastic reference material; native grade never overwrites the source grade.
Unequal Asy/Asz six-effect calibration found native shear-plane index swap; corrected V2->GAsz and V3->GAsy, preserving all previous symmetric-section behavior.
Shared query tools support signed same-result node differences and explicit cross-result controlling comparisons (root-owned implementation).
